i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":262,"startLine":1,"totalLines":262}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01648PW2HKj97tBkfZs94wgu","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfxf6SYJEmPUGbumPfJ4w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QZAWhC11ahsNHN6zF8y1Lq","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r1/spmv/spmv.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize the local block of an array with the same random values that\n//   fill() would produce, continuing the current random stream. Values that\n//   belong to other ranks are drawn and discarded.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the local block (size should be = count)\n//   begin: global index of the first local element\n//   count: number of local elements\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(double* A, const index_t begin, const index_t count, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < begin; ++i) {\n        rand();\n    }\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank walks the same global random sequence, so\n//   the matrix is identical regardless of rank count, but only the rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are stored locally.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          column indexes of the local elements\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size (rowEnd - rowBegin) + 1 holding indices to\n//                  local rows; last element is the index one past the last\n//                  local element\n//   nnzBegin:      global index of the first local element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, std::vector<index_t>& rowDelimiters, index_t& nnzBegin,\n                      const index_t n, const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n    cols.clear();\n    rowDelimiters.assign(rowEnd - rowBegin + 1, 0);\n    nnzBegin = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        const bool ownsRow = i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd;\n        if (i == rowBegin) {\n            nnzBegin = nnzAssigned;\n        }\n        if (ownsRow) {\n            rowDelimiters[i - rowBegin] = static_cast<index_t>(cols.size());\n        }\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (ownsRow) {\n                    cols.push_back(j);\n                }\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of local non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[rowEnd - rowBegin] = static_cast<index_t>(cols.size());\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int numRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numRanks);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; Values that\n//   belong to other ranks are drawn and discarded.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the local block (size should be = count)\n//   begin: global index of the first local element\n//   count: number of local elements\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(double* A, const index_t begin, const index_t count, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < begin; ++i) {\n        rand();\n    }\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank walks the same global random sequence, so\n//   the matrix is identical regardless of rank count, but only the rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are stored locally.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          column indexes of the local elements\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size (rowEnd - rowBegin) + 1 holding indices to\n//                  local rows; last element is the index one past the last\n//                  local element\n//   nnzBegin:      global index of the first local element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, std::vector<index_t>& rowDelimiters, index_t& nnzBegin,\n                      const index_t n, const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n    cols.clear();\n    rowDelimiters.assign(rowEnd - rowBegin + 1, 0);\n    nnzBegin = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        const bool ownsRow = i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd;\n        if (i == rowBegin) {\n            nnzBegin = nnzAssigned;\n        }\n        if (ownsRow) {\n            rowDelimiters[i - rowBegin] = static_cast<index_t>(cols.size());\n        }\n        for (index_t j = 0; <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01QZAWhC11ahsNHN6zF8y1Lq","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"23f27729-5b46-4aba-95b3-ca9a3b39a30c","uuid":"c45ff577-1f8f-42e9-b97b-400b8aaae889","timestamp":"2026-10-12T16:27:58.132Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/spmv_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r1/spmv/spmv.cpp","oldString":"        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", numRanks);\n    }","newString":"        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fillLocal\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize the local block of an array with the same random values that\n//   fill() would produce, continuing the current random stream. Values that\n//   belong to other ranks are drawn and discarded.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the local block (size should be = count)\n//   begin: global index of the first local element\n//   count: number of local elements\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fillLocal(double* A, const index_t begin, const index_t count, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < begin; ++i) {\n        rand();\n    }\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format. Every rank walks the same global random sequence, so\n//   the matrix is identical regardless of rank count, but only the rows\n//   [rowBegin, rowEnd) are stored locally.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          column indexes of the local elements\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size (rowEnd - rowBegin) + 1 holding indices to\n//                  local rows; last element is the index one past the last\n//                  local element\n//   nnzBegin:      global index of the first local element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   rowBegin:      first row owned by this rank\n//   rowEnd:        one past the last row owned by this rank\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(std::vector<index_t>& cols, std::vector<index_t>& rowDelimiters, index_t& nnzBegin,\n                      const index_t n, const index_t dim, const index_t rowBegin, const index_t rowEnd) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n    cols.clear();\n    rowDelimiters.assign(rowEnd - rowBegin + 1, 0);\n    nnzBegin = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        const bool ownsRow = i >= rowBegin && i < rowEnd;\n        if (i == rowBegin) {\n            nnzBegin = nnzAssigned;\n        }\n        if (ownsRow) {\n            rowDelimiters[i - rowBegin] = static_cast<index_t>(cols.size());\n        }\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                if (ownsRow) {\n                    cols.push_back(j);\n                }\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of local non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[rowEnd - rowBegin] = static_cast<index_t>(cols.size());\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int numRanks = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numRanks);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n        printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", numRanks);\n    }\n\n    // Rows are split into contiguous blocks; rank r owns [rowBound(r), rowBound(r + 1))\n    auto rowBound = [numRows, numRanks](int r) {\n        return static_cast<index_t>(static_cast<uint64_t>(numRows) * r / numRanks);\n    };\n    const index_t rowBegin = rowBound(rank);\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowBound(rank + 1);\n    const index_t localRows = rowEnd - rowBegin;\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    }\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols;                        // Column indices of local elements\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters;               // Row delimiters of local rows\n    index_t nnzBegin = 0;                               // Global index of first local element\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols, h_rowDelimiters, nnzBegin, nItems, numRows, rowBegin, rowEnd);\n    const index_t localNnz = static_cast<index_t>(h_cols.size());\n\n    // Same random stream as the original unseeded program (the C standard defines it as seed 1)\n    srand(1);\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector (replicated on every rank)\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    std::vector<double> h_val(localNnz);                // Non-zero values of local elements\n    fillLocal(h_val.data(), nnzBegin, localNnz, maxVal);\n\n    std::vector<double> h_out(localRows);               // Local part of the output vector\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution for the local rows\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        }\n        h_reference.resize(localRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation; each rank works on its rows without communication\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), localRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        const double avgTime = durationMs / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n\n        printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gathers the row blocks of a distributed vector onto the root (outside the timed region)\n    auto gatherRows = [numRows, numRanks, root, &rowBound](const std::vector<double>& local) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(numRanks);\n        std::vector<int> displs(numRanks);\n        for (int r = 0; r < numRanks; ++r) {\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rowBound(r));\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rowBound(r + 1) - rowBound(r));\n        }\n        std::vector<double> full(root ? numRows : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(local.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    full.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        return full;\n    };\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    std::vector<double> h_fullOut;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        h_fullOut = gatherRows(h_out);\n    }\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        print_results(h_fullOut, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        const std::vector<double> h_fullReference = gatherRows(h_reference);\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            const bool valid = verifyResults(h_fullReference.data(), h_fullOut.data(), numRows);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n            exitCode = valid ? 0 : 1;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&exitCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return exitCode;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":253,"oldLines":7,"newStart":253,"newLines":6,"lines":["         printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);","         printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);","         printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");","-        printf(\"Ranks: %d\\n\", numRanks);","     }"," ","     // Rows are split into contiguous blocks; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxfQdMfup8bd52kiW8LX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs under MPI. Only `spmv/spmv.cpp` and `spmv/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `spmv`, and no files were added.\n\n**Equivalence:** I compared against the original binary on 7 size/sparsity/max-value configs at 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, and 8 ranks, with `-v -r`. The result block (sum, min/max, samples, hash) and the validation outcome and exit code matched in every case. That includes sizes where some ranks own no rows (for example `-n 3` on 8 ranks).\n\n**Scaling:** On one 256-core node with `-n 8192 -s 10 -i 20`, the compute time was 207 ms at 1 rank, 110 ms at 2, and 54 ms at 4 (the original: 209 ms). I haven't run it on a real multi-node cluster.\n\n**Design choices:**\n- **Matrix generation:** the original builds the matrix from one sequential RNG stream, so each rank replays that stream and keeps only its own rows. Local memory for values and column indices is O(nnz/P). This replay is O(n²) work per rank but sits outside the timed region.\n- **Dense vector:** replicated on every rank (O(n) per rank), so the SpMV loop needs no communication.\n- **Partition:** contiguous equal row blocks, not nnz-balanced. Random sparsity keeps the imbalance small, but a heavily skewed matrix would load-balance poorly.\n- **Timing:** a barrier before the loop, then the slowest rank's time, printed in the same format as before.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. Results are gathered to rank 0 only for `-r` or `-v`, and the printing and verification code is unchanged.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` makes MPI unconditional, and the target links `MPI::MPI_CXX`.\n\n**Left as-is:** `numRows * numRows` is computed in 32 bits, so sizes of 65536 and up overflow. I kept it to preserve the original results, but it will limit very large runs.\n\nI didn't commit anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":683,"cache_read_input_tokens":63145,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":683},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"23f27729-5b46-4aba-95b3-ca9a3b39a30c","uuid":"88ca569a-46dd-4d84-afaf-c106c1313c41","timestamp":"2026-10-12T16:31:51.303Z","request_id":"req_011CfxfQd4pDQ5fo9LPrjZ1e"}
